name: [Part 1] empty title is a blank row
[Part 1] rejects an overlong title
[Part 1] rejects nonpositive width
[Part 2] greedy wrap preserves word order
test: assert format_book_titles(['The Lord of the Rings'], 11, True) == ['+-----------+', '|The Lord of|', '|the Rings  |', '+-----------+']

name: [Part 2] exact-fit packing without reflow
test: assert format_book_titles(['one two three'], 7, True) == ['+-------+', '|one two|', '|three  |', '+-------+']

name: [Part 2] normalizes ordinary spaces
test: assert format_book_titles(['  The   Hobbit  '], 10, True) == ['+----------+', '|The Hobbit|', '+----------+']

name: [Part 2] mixed wrapped and blank title blocks
[Part 2] punctuation stays with words across several rows
input: ['The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe'], 10, True
test: assert format_book_titles(['The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe'], 10, True) == ['+----------+', '|The Lion, |', '|the Witch |', '|and the   |', '|Wardrobe  |', '+----------+']

name: [Part 2] rejects an overlong word
[Part 2] repeated calls preserve input
test:
titles = ['  Dune ', 'The Hobbit']
original = titles.copy()
expected = ['+------+', '|Dune  |', '+------+', '|The   |', '|Hobbit|', '+------+']
assert format_book_titles(titles, 6, True) == expected
assert format_book_titles(titles, 6, True) == expected
assert titles == original
assert format_book_titles([], 6, True) == []
assert format_book_titles([''], 6, True) == ['+------+', '|      |', '+------+']
